events.description: It's Placer Nature Centers 35th Anniversary! Come play BINGO with us and let's raise funds to ensure they can continue to provide for the community! That 70’s Band brings the iconic soundtrack of the disco decade to High-Hand Brewing Co. with an energetic celebration of the music that defined the 1970s. From classic rock and soulful ballads to funk, disco, and pop favorites, their lively performance is packed with the unforgettable hits that filled dance floors and airwaves throughout the decade. Whether you grew up with these timeless songs or simply love great live music, you’ll be singing along all night. Grab a craft beer, bring your friends, and enjoy an evening of pure ’70s nostalgia at High-Hand Brewing Co.! Only guests 18 and older may attend our “On Stage” concerts.

events.title: On Stage with Bananafish — Let the Good Times Roll
events.description: Come join us at High-Hand Brewery to hear a live performance by Bananafish. Get ready to hit the dance floor! Serving up a high-energy mix of the ultimate rock and pop cover hits, Sacramento-area favorite Bananafish pays tribute to the classic dance-rock anthems that have kept generations moving for decades. Fronted by powerhouse vocalist Jimmy Oliver and backed by a razor-sharp rhythm section, this dynamic three-piece powerhouse is on a strict mission to keep you drinking, dancing, and smiling all night long. From timeless rock ‘n’ roll classics to driving pop-rock favorites, Bananafish delivers a massive, party-starting setlist guaranteed to pack the house and keep the crowd moving. Only guests 18 and older may attend our “On Stage” concerts.

events.title: On Stage with Diva ROX
